files.rationale: The KV namespace id replaces the placeholder, so the binding resolves and the rate limiter can persist counters. Without it the Worker cannot deploy.
data-chat flips to on, which makes the panel appear for every visitor, and the cache-busting ?v= is bumped in the same change per INV-OPS-002. This is the user-visible half of the deployment.
Runtime behaviour moves from NOT_VERIFIED to VERIFIED with nine evidence rows from production probes, and the unverified remainder is narrowed honestly to the rate-limit block branches.
The happy path is verified end to end, and the remaining gap is restated precisely: the panel's reader and the Worker's stream have not yet been watched together in a browser.
The spec recorded the chat happy path as never executed and the Worker's live behaviour as UNKNOWN. Both were true when written at the bootstrap revision and are now false.
INV-PAGES-003 said data-chat stays off until the Worker is deployed. It is deployed, so the invariant now states the live value and the condition for reverting it.
TASK-001 moves to verified: the three blocked requirements are complete, with the production evidence recorded as EV-004, EV-008 and EV-009.

traceability.verification: production probe returned a streamed first-person answer
